note: How YOU write the words on screen: how you ask for something at the end of a reel, the words you use, the words you refuse, the effects you love. Claude fills this in by asking you, one question at a time, and reads it before writing a single written word into a cut. A null means nobody has answered yet, so Claude asks rather than guessing. This is the file that stops your reels looking like everybody else's.

ask.notes: Every reel is different. Megs says what the ending should ask for while editing each reel; ask her then, never pick a default.
